conditioning.name: Field Session 1 - Intro
conditioning.purpose: Re-learn sprinting and changing pace without big fatigue.

warmUp.name: Field warm-up
warmUp.detail: 5 min brisk walk into easy jog, 4 min dynamic mobility (leg swings, lunges, hip openers), 3 min of 3 x 30 m build-ups.

main.name: Accelerations
main.detail: 6 x 10 m at 80% effort from a standing start. Walk back - 60 sec per rep.

main.name: Strides
main.detail: 6 x 50 m at 60% effort, walk back - 80 sec per rep.

main.name: Repeated sprints
main.detail: 2 sets of 5 x 20 m at 80%, one every 30 sec (2:30), then 2:30 walking rest.
roundDetails: 5 x 20 m every 30 sec + 2:30 rest
5 x 20 m every 30 sec + 2:30 rest

coolDown.name: Walk and stretch
coolDown.detail: Easy walk, then light stretching. Warm layers back on straight away.

conditioning.howToUse: Daylight only. Moulded studs or trainers on frost. If the pitch is frozen, skip the sprints. Stop any rep if a hamstring or calf tightens.
